from.place: proof, Step 1: naturality of the acyclic-resolution comparison used to prove naturality of the derived-composite isomorphism

title: Naturality of the acyclic-resolution comparison
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], $\mathcal A$ with enough injectives, and let $v:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a left exact additive functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Let $F,F'$ be objects of $\mathcal A$ and let $r:F\to I^\bullet$, $r':F'\to I'^\bullet$ be resolutions by $v$-acyclic objects [def-sp-acyclic] (that is, $I^m=I'^m=0$ for $m<0$ and the augmented complexes $0\to F\to I^0\to I^1\to\cdots$, $0\to F'\to I'^0\to I'^1\to\cdots$ are exact). Let $h:F\to F'$ be a morphism and $\varphi:I^\bullet\to I'^\bullet$ a morphism of complexes with $\varphi^0\circ r=r'\circ h$. Let $c_I^n:\mathcal H^n(v(I^\bullet))\xrightarrow{\sim}R^nv(F)$ and $c_{I'}^n:\mathcal H^n(v(I'^\bullet))\xrightarrow{\sim}R^nv(F')$ be the comparison isomorphisms of item 2 of [lemma-weil-pbc-leray-acyclicity] (induced by a morphism of complexes over the identity into an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions]). Then for every $n\geq0$ one has $c_{I'}^n\circ\mathcal H^n(v(\varphi))=R^nv(h)\circ c_I^n$.
